architectures.name: Sharded cluster with client-side routing
architectures.summary: Clients use consistent hashing to route to cache nodes directly.
architectures.bestWhen: Lowest latency and a stable topology.

architectures.name: Proxy tier in front of the cache
architectures.summary: A proxy layer routes requests, pools connections, and handles failover.
architectures.bestWhen: Many clients and languages need uniform behaviour.
drawbacks: Proxy tier must scale and stay available.
